citation.title: State-selective cross sections from ring polymer molecular dynamics

publisher_mirror_status: Landing page explicitly states that access to the full text is provided by Wiley; CC BY 4.0 is displayed.
reference_data_status: Digitized published figure markers. Not original machine-readable simulation data, not exact quantum reference values.

axes.pixel_origin: top-left, x rightwards, y downwards; integer pixel coordinates denote pixel centers

energy_conversion.definition: E_col = E_tot - (v + 1/2) h c (4407 cm^-1). This is the paper harmonic energy convention, not a measurement of full-PES trajectory energy.

method.type: Raster marker digitization with fitted circle centers and affine tick calibration; PDF contains embedded raster figures, not vector curves.
method.images: Extract image objects 79 (Fig 5) and 87 (Fig 6) with PyMuPDF extract_image; preserve original JPEG bytes.
method.axis_calibration: Identify labeled B-panel tick marks visually and by dark neutral pixels; least-squares linear fits using every listed anchor.
method.roi: Keep x >=1154; remove y<250 and x<1280 to exclude legend; keep y<=806 (Fig5), y<=792 (Fig6).
method.marker_grouping: Group occupied pixel columns separated by <=4 pixels; discard groups with fewer than 8 occupied columns.
method.circle_fit: Take the convex hull of magenta pixel coordinates in each x cluster. Fit 2*x*cx + 2*y*cy + c = x^2+y^2 by least squares after centering coordinates; derive center and radius.
method.sensitivity_checks: Refit within +/-18 pixels of each center with stricter RGB threshold (r>150,b>130,g<80,r>2g,b>2g) and looser threshold (r>110,b>100,g<130,r>1.6g,b>1.6g); compare centers. Also report bounding-box-center difference.
method.visual_review: Original full-resolution figures inspected; marker-center/outline overlays are temporary analysis files and are not redistributed.

uncertainty.digitization: Per-marker horizontal tolerances are +/-0.003 eV (Fig5B) and +/-0.002 eV (Fig6B); vertical tolerance +/-0.01 angstrom^2. These conservative graph-reading tolerances are not statistical confidence intervals. They cover axis pixel rounding, JPEG/color-threshold variation, line occlusion, and circle-center fitting at this resolution.
uncertainty.interpolation: Requested-energy CSV uses piecewise linear interpolation between neighboring digitized markers. These are derived estimates, not points explicitly reported by the authors. The interpolation model error between markers is NOT quantified.
uncertainty.digitization_only_interpolation_band: Evaluate the piecewise-linear interpolant at E +/- the horizontal tolerance, then expand vertically by +/-0.01 angstrom^2, clipping the lower edge at zero. This band propagates graph-reading tolerance only; it is not a confidence interval and does not include interpolation model error or simulation sampling error.
uncertainty.adjacent_marker_envelope: The requested-energy CSV also reports the minimum and maximum of the adjacent marker y-values, expanded by +/-0.01 angstrom^2. It describes the local plotted marker range; it bounds an intervening underlying curve only under an additional monotonicity assumption, and is not a confidence interval.
uncertainty.published_sampling: The paper states 40,000 trajectories per collision energy, but per-point N_reactive, b_max, and confidence intervals were not available. No published sampling uncertainty is reconstructed.
uncertainty.zero_cross_section: Small digitized values within +/-0.01 angstrom^2 of zero cannot establish nonzero reactivity or an exact threshold.
uncertainty.comparison: Compare total-energy conventions consistently. Different v at equal E_tot does not mean equal collision energy. Compare new simulation confidence intervals, unresolved bounds, convergence uncertainties, and reference graph-reading/interpolation limits separately.
